rule: Every film closes with one of five logo-only templates: the avatar image and the bold SIMPLEDEAV wordmark. No label, monogram, handle, tag, URL, QR code or second logo.

templates.name: Aurora
templates.character: Portrait held in a soft ring of light, a small precise wordmark and a single luminous horizon.
templates.bestFor: The house default. Every channel, vertical and wide.

templates.name: Atlas
templates.character: An architectural grid with the avatar as a small seal and a precise wordmark on a measured baseline.
templates.bestFor: Films that want a quiet, architectural close.

templates.name: Axis
templates.character: A horizontal lockup with a squared portrait, a hairline rule and a precise accent mark.
templates.bestFor: Wide films, YouTube end screens and sponsor-facing cuts.

templates.name: Editorial
templates.character: An asymmetric, left-aligned stack with generous negative space, a fine rule system and directional light.
templates.bestFor: Case studies, documentary closes and designed title cards.

templates.name: Orbit
templates.character: A portrait inside a slowly turning orbital system, set against a quiet field of stars and wide-tracked type.
templates.bestFor: Premium documentary closes, series finales and launch films.
